test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Out of an earning of Rs. 720, Pankaj spends 65%. How much does he save?
solution:
**Given:**

Out of an earning of Rs. 720, Pankaj spends 65%.

**Calculation:**

Savings of Pankaj = 720 × (100 - 65)%

⇒ 720 × 35%

⇒ 252

**∴ He saves Rs. 252.**
